note: SPDX ids an asset may carry. A recording behind a heard prompt needs an attribution whatever its licence. Not allowed, by design: any NonCommercial or NoDerivatives licence, and ShareAlike or copyleft terms, which would bind the lessons that use the asset.

text.note: Licences under which a source's text may enter the CC BY core (`adoptable`), the share-alike licences that are kept out of it (`shareAlike`), and the deed each licence's `licenceUrl` must name. Anything else (NonCommercial, NoDerivatives, all rights reserved, a licence nobody recognised) is reference only: codes and links, never content.
